subject: ThirstCast alert: thirstwave in Mandya
body:
ThirstCast: Mandya is in a thirstwave (status ACTIVE, day 4) on 2023-10-05.
Excess ET0 over the 7-day window: 0.7 mm (sum of daily ET0 above the local day-of-year p90 threshold).
Extra crop water (estimate, Kc +-10%): paddy: 2,972-3,633 L/acre; sugarcane: 3,096-3,784 L/acre
Extra lake/reservoir evaporation (estimate, upper bound): KRS: 92,820,000 L
Caveat: District-centroid estimate (~10 km grid). All litre figures are estimates.
